title: CastBot Update
subtitle: CastBot Premium Goes Live — Challenge Rewards, the Marooning Planner & Add Cast

cards.title: CastBot Premium Is Live
desc: Support CastBot from Ko-fi and unlock the full host toolkit.
Redeem it yourself with your Ko-fi email — no waiting on
anyone. One subscription covers one server, and you can move
it to next season's server whenever you like.

cards.title: Challenge Days & Rewards
desc: Season Planner rounds now take a challenge length, and a
linked reward challenge that shares the same budget — so
adding a reward never stretches your round. The Calendar
paints reward days, and the Schedule gains a column.

cards.title: The Marooning Planner
desc: Casting decisions now lead the tab, one line per player,
grouped by draft tribe with a size on every tribe. Only
outstanding work is flagged: who has no offer yet, who has
not replied, who declined. Scores moved to the Casting tab.

cards.title: Add Cast
desc: Someone joining who never applied? Pick them from a list and
CastBot builds their application channel exactly as if they
had clicked Apply themselves. Late additions and off-Discord
recruits now flow through Casting and Marooning normally.

cards.title: A Simpler Menu
desc: Tools is gone — everything it held now lives where you would
look for it. Map tools gained a Utilities submenu, timers
became Stopwatch and Snowflake, and there is a written user
guide plus a Support Server link on the main menu.

cards.title: Casting Offer Fixes
desc: A production member clicking an applicant's placement card
used to wipe it, leaving them unable to accept. Editing your
apply button also quietly erased your Season Planner
estimates. Both fixed, both covered by tests.

underHood: Draft tribes can no longer leak a casting decision
Manage Roles alone opens Season Manager again
